leadText: Carrie Savage is a voice actor for the English-language dub of .
plainText:
Carrie Savage is a voice actor for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Savage was born on April 8, 1980 in Atlanta, Georgia. She first worked on the during where she voiced Christie. In addition to her voice work, Savage has also worked as voice director on several series.
